status: CONFIRMATORY FOLLOW-UP of one post-hoc signal (committed before these runs)
trigger: Measured browser cells: on 0/12 vs off 3/12 (paired sign test p=0.25, the pre-registered H3b test, not significant). Exploratory controls: offdelay 4/12, onnowait 3/12, outage 1/3. Post hoc, on vs all other browser arms pooled gives Fisher p=0.048 (unadjusted, chosen after seeing the data). This replication re-tests the unchanged on and off arms on fresh pairs.
runs: browser task, fresh pairs 13..24 (new tokens), arms on and off exactly as in PREREG.json (harness unchanged for these arms), seeded order inside each pair (20261004), driver pinned_0_21_0; 24 runs in plan_replication.json
hypothesis: R1: the shadow-on configuration lowers the browser oracle pass rate relative to off.
test: exact paired sign test on oracle-discordant pairs (two-sided), and Fisher exact on the 2x2 of pass counts; reported with the measured pairs both separately and pooled (24 pairs).
decision_rule: R1 supported only if the replication alone gives p < 0.05 in the direction on < off. Otherwise the measured on-arm 0/12 is reported as not replicated. Either way, the information-flow claim (H3a) is unaffected; R1 concerns a resource/timing path, not shadow output.
claim_boundary: Small n; GPU shared with other lanes; temperature-0 outputs are not deterministic on this server (first-call divergence with identical inputs in 5/24 measured pairs).
